title: Umar's Concern for the People
paragraphs: Umar bin Khattab adalah seorang pemimpin. Pada malam hari, ia memeriksa keadaan rakyat biasa. Kadang ia menemukan masalah yang belum ada orang ceritakan kepadanya. Suatu malam, ia menemukan keluarga yang memiliki sangat sedikit makanan. Ia sendiri membawa bahan makanan kepada mereka. Ia tidak hanya mengirim orang lain.

Orang di sekitar Umar terkejut. Ia memiliki banyak tugas, tetapi ia tetap peduli kepada satu keluarga dan masalah mereka. Kisah ini mengajarkan pemimpin untuk memperhatikan orang yang membutuhkan bantuan. Kepemimpinan yang baik bukan hanya memberi perintah dari jauh.
answerKey: Umar ibn al-Khattab was a leader. At night, he checked how ordinary people were living. Sometimes he found problems that no one had told him about. One night, he found a family with very little food. He carried supplies to them himself. He did not only send another person. People around Umar were surprised. He had many duties, but he still cared about one family and their problem. This story teaches leaders to notice people who need help. Good leadership is not only about giving orders from far away.
